issue.title: Comm error with RPi connected to PX4.
issue.body:

•	RPI-3 running w/Python 3.7 mounted on the rover.
•	Serial interface between the PX4 and RPI.
•	MAVLINK works – used this for testing the serial link
	sudo mavproxy.py --master=/dev/serial0 --baudrate 9600 --aircraft MyCopter

•	MAVSDK loaded via pip3 install mavsdk
•	Using mavsdk_server_linux-armv7

comments.body:
It sounds like you are using ArduPilot (ArduRover in this case) and not PX4.
MAVSDK is not compatible with ArduPilot (yet), see: #728.

I think it is against PX4: "Serial interface between the PX4 and RPI."

But it is a rover :innocent:.

@ssarfati: Actually, are you sure that you are using PX4 and not Ardupilot? It is not clear to me if Mission Planner works with PX4. Note that "PX4" is not the same thing as "Pixhawk". You could be running Ardupilot on a Pixhawk, and that would not be PX4 :blush:.

Hi, Sorry for the confusion here. I have only been part of this environment for a few weeks. I did not realize that MAVSDK does not currently work with Ardupilot. Ok, I will switch over to PX4.  I just loaded QGroundControl and loaded V1.10.1 of PX4. The unit boots up, but I don't see the Airframe for Rover. What airframe should I use? The instructions indicates that it does exist. In the meantime, I will just selected a quadcopter and tested the RPI with the PX4.  IT appears to be working. I will do more testing tomorrow.

Ok, good to know :-). So I'm closing this for now, since it's not a connection issue between MAVSDK and PX4 :innocent:.

About the configuration for the rover, I would suggest you ask in #rover on the PX4 Slack! :blush:
Yes, rover support is very basic in PX4, and I'm not sure how well MAVSDK works with PX4 rover.
